release.notes: Settings and saved passwords stay intact on the first start after the update: they move to the phone's secure storage, and the evDash account backup for a reinstall keeps working; a Loxone Miniserver with its own HTTPS certificate needs that certificate in Settings; Live stream 1h keeps a failed upload on the phone (Retry upload, Export, Delete), and its extended collection is now a switch, off by default; date and time pickers and built-in buttons follow the app language; nameplate photo zoom and clearer send errors; History keeps its scroll position; Kona 64/39 and Ioniq 38 AC charger readings; EV6 77 rear temperatures; VW ID. and Enyaq A/C compressor power; Tesla energy, LEAF rpm when parked, Atto 2 45.12 kWh speed; Chinese wording.
